rationale: Motor vehicle collision with total loss and bodily injury resulting from impact of other vehicle.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 am by an unbraked vehicle traveling ~35 mph, resulting in total loss of vehicle (trunk crushed into back seat) and injuries to the policyholder including whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle going approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: entire trunk crushed into back seat, vehicle totaled
